title: Prepositions of place - in, at, on - English grammar | English In A Minute
speaker: BBC Learning English
zh: 【BBC Learning English】地點介係詞 - in, at, on - 英語文法 |一分鐘英語（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Hello, I'm Sam and in this lesson we're going to look at the differences between
cues.en: Hello, I'm Sam and in this lesson we're going to look at the differences between
cues.zh: 你好，我是 Sam，在本課中我們將瞭解以下內容之間的差異

cues.text: 'At' can be used to talk about a single specific location.
cues.en: 'At' can be used to talk about a single specific location.

cues.text: Or: I'm at the BBC right now.
cues.en: Or: I'm at the BBC right now.

cues.text: 'On' is used in relation to a surface.
cues.en: 'On' is used in relation to a surface.

cues.text: And 'in' is used to talk about a three-dimensional space,
cues.en: And 'in' is used to talk about a three-dimensional space,

cues.text: So to help you remember these rules, try to think of a concert:
cues.en: So to help you remember these rules, try to think of a concert:
cues.zh: 因此，為了幫助您記住這些規則，請嘗試想像一場音樂會：

cues.text: The band is on the stage.
cues.en: The band is on the stage.

cues.text: And my friends are in the crowd.
cues.en: And my friends are in the crowd.
cues.zh: 我的朋友們也在人群中。

cues.text: And where are you right now?
cues.en: And where are you right now?
